added.t: FX is one of the world's largest financial markets, where currencies are traded in pairs. For active traders, it offers a different kind of market exposure shaped by macro events, interest rates, and global liquidity.
Product terms, leverage limits, and availability differ significantly by jurisdiction. Always check local conditions.
Whether you’re new to FX or comparing brokers for the first time, this keeps you informed before you commit to anything.
